descriptionPlain:
Remote, Europe, Full-Time, Individual Contributor
 
🟣 Who We Are
At Yuno, we are building the payment infrastructure that allows all companies to participate in the global market. Founded by seasoned experts from the payments and tech industries, our technology provides access to leading payment capabilities, enabling companies to engage customers confidently and maintain global operations through seamless integrations.
We empower high-performing teams at brands like InDrive, McDonald’s, Rappi, and Viva Aerobus to integrate over 1,000 payment methods via a single API. By leveraging advanced AI and the latest technologies, we orchestrate smart routing and fraud prevention across 80+ countries.
 
 
 
🟣 How Yuno will challenge you
 
Own the full sales cycle from prospecting to close, managing complex enterprise deals with multiple stakeholders and timelines.
Identify and pursue new business opportunities through outbound prospecting, industry events, referrals, and strategic networking across key European markets.
Engage C-level and senior decision-makers at enterprise merchants, running consultative discovery and tailoring Yuno's value proposition to each client's specific needs.
Develop deep knowledge of target verticals with global operations, including e-commerce, iGaming/gambling, travel, mobility, and SaaS.
Collaborate closely with Customer Account Managers and Solutions Engineers to deliver compelling proposals and ensure a seamless handoff from sale to implementation.
Build and maintain accurate pipeline records in CRM, providing full visibility into deal stages and forecasting.
Stay ahead of trends in the payments and fintech landscape to identify competitive differentiation opportunities.
Operate with a founder mentality — you will be expected to build your own playbook, not follow one that already exists.
 
🟣 The skills you need
 
English fluency is mandatory. Fluency in other languages is an advantage.
Proven experience in enterprise sales or business development.
Proven track record selling to enterprise clients with complex multi-stakeholder environments and long sales cycles.
Strong understanding of payment technologies, financial services, and industry regulations.
Demonstrable startup and/or scale-up experience — you must be comfortable operating without structure and building your own pipeline.
Strong consultative selling skills: able to navigate complex organizations and position Yuno strategically.
Self-motivated and results-driven — this is not a role where leads are handed to you.
Familiarity with CRM platforms (Salesforce, HubSpot) and sales tooling.
 
 
🟣  What Yuno offers you
Competitive base compensation + 50/50 OTE structure.
Remote work — You can work from anywhere in Europe!
Home office bonus — A one-time allowance to help you create your ideal home office.
Work equipment.
Stock options.
Health Plan, no matter where you are.
Flexible Days off.
Professional and personal growth courses.
High impact and high velocity environment with some of the most talented and ambitious people you will ever work with.
A chance to shape the story of a company and a category from the ground up.

descriptionPlain:
Latam · Remote · Full Time · Technical Engineering Leader · +5 Years of Experience

Who We Are
At Yuno, we are building the payment infrastructure that enables all companies to participate in the global market. Founded by a team of seasoned experts in the payments and IT industries, Yuno provides a high-performance payment orchestrator. Our technology offers companies access to leading payment capabilities, allowing them to engage customers confidently and maintain global business operations with seamless payment integrations worldwide.

About The Role
We are orchestrating the best high-performing team!
If you are an Engineering Manager passionate about building and scaling world-class teams, joining Yuno will allow you to transform that passion into real high-impact solutions, contributing to our global expansion.
As an Engineering Manager, you will lead our Integrations team — a group of engineers responsible for connecting Yuno's platform to PSPs, acquirers, and payment gateways worldwide. You will own the technical direction and delivery of a critical piece of our infrastructure, while growing and developing your team in a fast-moving, global environment.
Your Contribution Will Be
Lead the technical evolution of Yuno's merchant experience, focused on Core platform, APIs, and payment integrations.
Own system and integration architecture connecting backend services and payment flows.
Contribute hands-on to development, architecture decisions, and code reviews.
Ensure scalable, maintainable, and well-documented solutions for enterprise merchants.
Collaborate with Product, Backend, and Payments teams to align platform and merchant needs.
Drive engineering best practices in API design, testing, and performance.
Support and mentor engineers through technical guidance and architectural direction.

Skills You Need
Minimum Qualifications
Proven experience managing and growing engineering teams, including hiring, coaching, and performance management.
Strong ability to drive technical decision-making and manage competing priorities in a fast-moving environment.
Experience in payments companies , payments-related teams or with PSP integrations.
Deep experience in payments infrastructure, including network tokens, routing, and transaction optimization.
Excellent communication skills to engage with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Solid hands-on backend engineering experience, with proficiency in Java, Golang, Kotlin or similar languages.
Strong understanding of microservices and event-driven architectures, APIs, and integration patterns.
Experience with SQL and relational databases.
Knowledge of secure software development practices and OWASP principles.
Champion of AI-first development — experience setting standards for AI-assisted coding, automated testing, and code generation using LLMs and tools like Claude Code or similar.
Experience delivering in agile environments, adapting processes to what actually works for the team.
Advanced English; conversational Spanish is a plus.

What We Offer at Yuno
Competitive Compensation.
Remote Work – You can work from everywhere!
Home Office Bonus – A one-time allowance to help you create your ideal home office.
Work Equipment.
Stock Options.
Health Plan wherever you are.
Flexible Days Off.
Language, Professional, and Personal Growth courses.
